customer_id.meaning: Primary id of the customer profile (content hash or seed id).

employee_status.meaning: Whether the customer is a current or retired PCB employee, as maintained by Human Resources.

verification_id.meaning: Primary id of the verification record, one per customer (content hash of the customer id).

verified.meaning: Whether identity verification passed; once true it never returns to false.

handoff_id.meaning: Primary id of the handoff record (content hash of customer id and reason).

created_at.format: ISO timestamp, exactly as returned by ctx.now()

amount_due.format: USD, 2 decimal places, may be negative
amount_due.meaning: What the lessee owes now; identically charges minus payments and credits over the rental's ledger rows; negative is a credit.

co_lessee_name.meaning: Full name of the co-lessee exactly as on the signature card; empty when none.

deputy_names.meaning: Full names of authorized deputies exactly as on the signature card, separated by semicolons; empty when none.

autopay_checking_account_id.meaning: PCB checking account paying rent automatically (foreign key -> checking_accounts); empty when none.

drill_notice_date.meaning: Date the certified drilling notice was mailed; empty when none.

safebox_txn_id.meaning: Primary id of the box rental ledger row.

safebox_rental_id.meaning: Rental the row posts to (foreign key -> safebox_rentals).

customer_id.meaning: Lessee (foreign key -> customers).

event_type.meaning: Event family of the row, verbatim from the safe deposit box charter.

amount.meaning: Magnitude of the row, always positive; the family's direction gives whether the amount due rises or falls.

rent_period_start.meaning: First day of the rental year a rent charge or late fee relates to; empty otherwise.

rent_period_end.meaning: Last day of the rental year a rent charge relates to; empty otherwise.

discount_type.meaning: Discount applied to a rent charge; none otherwise.

discount_pct.meaning: Discount percent applied to a rent charge; 0 otherwise.

payment_method.meaning: How a payment was made; none otherwise.

reference_number.meaning: Payment reference number; empty on bank-generated rows.

counterparty_account_id.meaning: PCB checking account paying or receiving funds; empty otherwise.

service_code.meaning: Which service a service fee is for; none otherwise.

credit_reason.meaning: Why a credit was given; none otherwise.

source_item_id.meaning: The charge a credit offsets; empty otherwise.

refund_destination.meaning: Where a resulting credit balance was paid out; none when the credit only reduced the amount due.

access_id.meaning: Primary id of the vault entry record.

safebox_rental_id.meaning: Rental whose box was opened (foreign key -> safebox_rentals).

customer_id.meaning: Lessee of the rental (foreign key -> customers).

event_type.meaning: Event family of the row, verbatim from the safe deposit box charter.

access_time.meaning: Time the entry was signed in, Eastern Time.

accessor_role.meaning: Capacity in which the person entered.

accessor_name.meaning: Name of the person entering exactly as on the photo identification presented.

safebox_request_id.meaning: Primary id of the safe deposit box service request.

customer_id.meaning: Lessee making the request (foreign key -> customers).

requested_variant.meaning: Box size asked for in a size change; none otherwise.

created_at.format: ISO timestamp, exactly as returned by ctx.now()
